context: Re-measure the study's noisiest cells at depth (N>=5/arm on opus), both arms in the same window, before-arm pinned by averaging cold draws. Resolves N=1 anomalies from rounds 1-5. Triggered as the optim-rollout fallback: the audit/fix queue found 0 fixes to apply, so remaining quota went to firming up the noisiest existing cells.

methodology.arm_A: cold (no skills-quality/freshness SKILL.md or script; DOES inspect target skills since auditing them is the task)
methodology.arm_B: with-skill (read SKILL.md, run its script read-only, no --update)
methodology.before_arm: pinned by averaging >=5 cold draws (not a single N=1 draw)
methodology.cell: MEDIAN + spread; ratio computed on medians (and on pinned mean for the before arm)
methodology.token_accounting: input + output + cache_creation_input_tokens, deduped by (sessionId,requestId), cache_read excluded. Matches scripts/build-review-stats.mjs + the round-1-5 study.

prior_rounds.R5_note: N=1 anomaly: cold arm short-circuited at 31K

skills-quality|opus.verdict: Strong saver at depth (+76%, N=5/arm). OVERTURNS the R5 -62% anomaly, which came from a short-circuited cold arm (31K). With the cold arm doing the full audit (116-131K) and the script-backed skill running the audit in ~0 LLM tokens (~30K total), the save is large and tight. arm_A spread 116-131K (sd ~5K), arm_B spread 28.6-34.5K (sd ~2K) - both arms stable, no N=1 fragility.

prior_rounds.note: all near-zero/negative at N=1; R1 cold arm was shallow (135K/9 turns)

skills-freshness|opus.verdict: Strong saver at depth (+76%, N=5/arm). OVERTURNS the prior near-zero/negative opus rounds. At depth the cold arm does a full staleness audit (172-200K, 16-31 turns, verifying file:line citations against source) while the sha256 change-detection script short-circuits unchanged skills (~46K). The prior near-zero numbers were N=1 artifacts of an unusually shallow cold arm. arm_A sd ~10K, arm_B sd ~5K - stable.

skills-quality|sonnet.verdict: Strong saver at N=3 (+85%). Overturns the R1 -12% sign-flip. arm_B just runs the script (14-16K); cold arm reads all 14 SKILL.md (93-102K).

skills-quality|haiku.verdict: Consistent strong saver (+54%, N=3) - matches R5 (+54%) closely. The investigation-collapse pattern: haiku scouts exhaustively when cold (54-118K), benefits most from a directed script.

skills-freshness|sonnet.verdict: Strong saver at N=3 (+78%). Cold arm does deep citation-verification (140-151K, up to 109 turns); script-backed skill short-circuits via sha256 (~33K). Prior rounds drifted +43/+14/+1 as the N=1 cold arm got cheaper run-to-run; at depth the cold arm reliably does real work.

skills-freshness|haiku.verdict: THE headline swing cell, now firmly positive (+73%, N=3). The R1 -70% was a pre-fix N=1 artifact (unusually cheap cold arm, 64K); post-fix it went +20% (R2) -> +48% (R5) -> +73% (N=3 here). Confirms the central study claim: bounded script-backed guidance reliably saves haiku-class tokens.
